Which of the numbers is right is not something we can tell from outside, and
this report does not try. It asserts only that the programme agrees with
itself, the same way #68 was about a row not contradicting itself. Correct any
one of them and it goes green.

misread. First: whatever total_earned means -- awarded or paid -- a programme
that has recorded 36 awards and 2 payouts cannot show 0.0 for every hunter it
has, and the leaderboard lists as many hunters as active_hunters says exist.
Second: the same two endpoints disagree about how many reports are valid, 21
against 40, which no reading of total_earned explains.

program_status reads live, so we are trying to work out whether that is a

reports.status_notes:
Both questions answered, plus a data fix.

1) Filtered view, not data loss: GET /api/v1/bounty/reports is deliberately the public post-validation view (VALIDATED and later stages only), so unverified reports — which can name unpatched issues — are not published. Unresolved items are retained; an authenticated submitter can read their own PENDING report at GET /reports/{id}. Nothing is dropped.

2) Yes — your six earlier reports (#7–#12) are bound to hunter profile 5 with wallet 0xde9CeAaB301A9e47b1bAcd448B3DDbbA85e83398 (verified in bug_bounty_reports.wallet_address / hunter_id on 2026-09-04).

3) validated_at was null on the 15 pre-June FIXED rows because they were closed before per-stage timestamps existed (validation and fix were recorded in one step). Those 15 rows now carry validated_at = fixed_at (or updated_at where fixed_at was also null) together with an explicit status_notes line saying the stamp is historical and not a fresh re-verification — no silent backdating. Every report closed since 2026-09-04 12:26 UTC (#46 onward) is stamped triaged_at → validated_at → fixed_at as it moves.

Reproduce: GET https://cymetica.com/api/v1/bounty/reports → count validated_at nulls → 0.
